slide_title: Using  FF NN  for Multiplication of a Vector by a Matrix

equations: [y₁ y₂ y₃ y₄] = Sigmoid( [X₁ X₂ X₃ X₄] · [[W₁₁ W₂₁ W₃₁ W₄₁],[W₁₂ W₂₂ W₃₂ W₄₂],[W₁₃ W₂₃ W₃₃ W₄₃],[W₁₄ W₂₄ W₃₄ W₄₄]] + (b₁, b₂, b₃, b₄) )

layout.arrangement: Light-gray slide with thin dark-red frame; bold red title centered at top; yellow slide-number circle '9' at top-right; below the title two rounded panels side by side: a tall narrow white panel on the left (~22% width, nearly full height) containing a fully connected 4-input / 4-neuron network diagram, and a wide light-gray panel on the right (~63% width, upper 40% of slide) containing the vector-by-matrix equation built from boxed vectors, a 4×4 weight matrix, curly braces, and a '+' sign; a solid black strip runs across the very bottom edge.

layout.hierarchy: The red bold title dominates first; the 4×4 W-matrix is the visually densest block; the neural-network diagram is the tallest element; color-coded weight labels (blue/purple/orange/green) and pink X nodes pop against the white panel; blue braces and '= Sigmoid' are mid-weight; green y/b arrows and labels are the smallest marks.

visual_elements.description: Fully connected feed-forward network, left panel. Header 'Input Word X' (word 'X' in red). Four pink circular input nodes stacked vertically, labeled X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄. Four white circular neurons to their right, each containing 'Σ' plus a small sigmoid-curve glyph, and a tiny multicolor pie icon (blue/purple/green wedges) on the neuron's left rim. All 16 input-to-neuron connections drawn as thin light-purple lines. Weight labels grouped by source node: beside X₁ (blue): W₁₁, W₂₁, W₃₁, W₄₁; beside X₂ (purple): W₁₂, W₂₂, W₃₂, W₄₂; beside X₃ (orange): W₁₃, W₂₃, W₃₃, W₄₃; beside X₄ (green): W₁₄, W₂₄, W₃₄, W₄₄. Each neuron emits a short green arrow to the right ending at labels y₁, y₂, y₃, y₄; each neuron also receives a short green arrow from below coming from labels b₁, b₂, b₃, b₄.

Equation-as-graphic, right panel, reading left to right: (1) red 'Y' with superscript 'T' above a horizontal row of four yellow rounded boxes labeled y₁, y₂, y₃, y₄; (2) blue bold-italic text '= Sigmoid'; (3) large dark-blue curly brace '{'; (4) horizontal row of four pink rounded boxes labeled X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄ with a red bold 'X' centered beneath them; (5) a 4×4 matrix on a light-green rounded rectangle, each cell a small yellow box: row 1 = W₁₁ W₂₁ W₃₁ W₄₁ (blue text), row 2 = W₁₂ W₂₂ W₃₂ W₄₂ (purple text), row 3 = W₁₃ W₂₃ W₃₃ W₄₃ (orange text), row 4 = W₁₄ W₂₄ W₃₄ W₄₄ (green text); (6) large dark-blue curly brace '}'; (7) red bold '+' sign; (8) a vertical column of four yellow rounded boxes labeled b₁, b₂, b₃, b₄ enclosed by a pair of large red parentheses. Overall meaning: Yᵀ = Sigmoid( X·W + b ).
Slide-number badge: yellow circle with dark-red outline containing the numeral '9' in dark red, positioned at the top-right corner.
Small white mouse-pointer arrow with black outline floating in the empty area of the right panel below the y₁–y₄ row (screen-capture artifact of the live presentation).

imagery: No photographs or illustrations. Iconography only: four Σ neuron circles each with a small sigmoid-curve glyph and a multicolor (blue/purple/green) pie icon on the left rim; four pink circular input nodes; yellow rounded number badge '9'; small white mouse-cursor arrow in the right panel.
typography_notes: Sans-serif (Arial/Tahoma-like) throughout. Title ~28pt bold, red, title case with wide double spaces after 'Using' and 'FF NN'. Panel header 'Input Word X' ~14pt bold black with the 'X' enlarged and red. All indices are true subscripts (X₁, W₁₁, y₁, b₁); 'Yᵀ' uses a superscript T. '= Sigmoid' is bold italic blue. Weight labels ~9pt bold, color-coded by source node. No all-caps text, no serif fonts, no numbered bullets.
animation_state: Slide appears fully built — all 4 inputs, 16 weight labels, 4 neurons, and the complete equation are visible; nothing is mid-reveal. A mouse cursor is visible in the right panel, indicating a live-recorded session, but no build state is in progress.
recreation_brief: 1. Create a 4:3 slide with background #E8E8E8 and add a thin dark-red (#800000) rectangular frame around the slide edge. 2. Title text box top-center (x 8–86%, y 8–16%): 'Using  FF NN  for Multiplication of a Vector by a Matrix', Arial bold 28pt, #C00000, centered (keep the double spaces). 3. Top-right: oval ~0.5" diameter, fill #FFFF99, outline #800000 1.5pt, text '9' bold #800000. 4. Left panel: rounded rectangle x 7–29%, y 17–97%, fill #FFFFFF, outline #404040 1.5pt. 5. Inside its top-left, add header 'Input Word ' black bold 14pt + 'X' red bold 18pt. 6. Draw four pink circles (fill #FF99CC, outline #CC6699, ~0.35") at x≈10%, y≈27/49/66/84%, labeled X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄ (black bold, subscript digits). 7. Draw four white neuron circles (~0.45", outline #808080) at x≈24% at the same heights; inside each place 'Σ' (~16pt) plus a small sigmoid-curve glyph, and add a tiny pie icon of blue/purple/green wedges on each neuron's left rim. 8. Connect every Xᵢ to every neuron with 16 thin (0.75pt) light-purple (#CC99CC) lines. 9. Add 16 weight labels (~9pt bold, subscript digits) grouped beside each input node: next to X₁ in #0033CC: W₁₁, W₂₁, W₃₁, W₄₁; next to X₂ in #9933CC: W₁₂, W₂₂, W₃₂, W₄₂; next to X₃ in #FF9900: W₁₃, W₂₃, W₃₃, W₄₃; next to X₄ in #009900: W₁₄, W₂₄, W₃₄, W₄₄. 10. From each neuron draw a short green (#009900) rightward arrow to labels y₁–y₄ (green bold); below each neuron draw a green upward arrow from labels b₁–b₄ (green bold). 11. Right panel: rounded rectangle x 30–93%, y 17–56%, fill #EEEEEE, outline #404040 1.5pt. 12. Build the equation left-to-right: red bold 'Y' with superscript 'T' (~20pt) above a row of four yellow (#FFFF99, orange #E6A23C border) rounded boxes labeled y₁–y₄; then blue (#0000CC) bold-italic '= Sigmoid'; then a large dark-blue (#000099) '{' brace; then a row of four pink (#FF99CC, red border) boxes labeled X₁–X₄ with red bold 'X' centered below them; then a light-green (#CCFFCC) rounded rectangle containing a 4×4 grid of small yellow cells labeled row 1: W₁₁ W₂₁ W₃₁ W₄₁ (blue), row 2: W₁₂ W₂₂ W₃₂ W₄₂ (purple), row 3: W₁₃ W₂₃ W₃₃ W₄₃ (orange), row 4: W₁₄ W₂₄ W₃₄ W₄₄ (green); then a matching dark-blue '}' brace; then a red bold '+'; then large red parentheses enclosing a vertical column of four yellow boxes labeled b₁–b₄. 13. Optionally place a small white mouse-cursor arrow icon at ~x 42%, y 51% inside the right panel for pixel fidelity. 14. Add a solid black rectangle across the full bottom edge (y 97–100%).
